system.unidentifiedDesc: An odd looking talisman with strange symbols carved in it.
system.description:
This item is a round amulet that may be found on a chain; this one corresponds to the element of Water.

It is engraved with a triangle in the center and a symbol above it (one of the ten symbols of the elemental ranks). On the Prime Plane, the user may press the central symbol while casting a conjure elemental spell; the talisman will reverse the effect, sending the wearer into the appropriate elemental plane. While wearing the talisman, the user can breathe elemental matter as if it were pure, clean air, and he gains in vision (normally 120'-1,200' range, depending on conditions).
